answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 60283 Country: India Title: zakah Question: How to calculate zakah? Answer ID: 60283 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 987/793/D=09/1436) You should calculate your capital every lunar year on the date in which you first turned sahib nisab. Calculate cash, silver, gold, business goods, the debt if you have taken from someone together and deduct the amount that you have taken as a debt from someone then pay its zakah at the rate of 2.5% on the total amount. You should calculate your zakah in this way. Whatsoever amount is applicable to be paid as zakah you may pay it in one time or in fractions. If you want to know more then submit your query again. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
